description: SEO search intent classifier (batch) — Classify up to 50 search keywords by intent (informational, navigational, commercial, transactional, local) and funnel stage (awareness, consideration, decision, retention), with a topic cluster per keyword. Each label is snapped to the allowed set and cross-checked against offline keyword-modifier rules (buy, best, vs, near me, login, how...) - rulesAgree flags disagreements; if the model is unavailable the rules still answer. Returns per-keyword intent, stage, confidence, recommended content format, intent distribution and topic clusters. keywords = comma-separated, || separated or a JSON array; optional brand=. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

keywords.description: e.g. buy running shoes,best running shoes 2026,how to train for a marathon,nike login,running store near me

name: ai_search_intent
